notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
Many people encountered trouble in the novella walkthrough while playing the game, which spoiled the overall impression of the game.
It was fixed:
- Error that popped up on the branch with Blad and beyond
- Also fixed a bug with the accrual of points when the right choice

notes.title: News about chapter 2
notes.content:
Hi. It's been a while since I've had any news on the game, but I can say that the silence wasn't just a lack of desire to work, and I finished the second chapter for the game.
 
- What plans remain:
Tedious but important: Editing.

- Backgrounds. They will increase in number and variation. There will also be new characters, but not many.

- The main characters will have new clothes, which is only half-exciting. First of all, cool, they won't be wearing the same clothes, and secondly, I'll have to draw them.
